hits.title: ASSA ABLOY To Acquire Gunnebo Entrance Control
hits.snippet: ASSA ABLOY has signed an agreement to acquire Gunnebo Entrance Control, an international provider of pedestrian access and entrance control systems. ASSA ABLOY has signed an agreement to acquire Gunnebo Entrance Control, an international provider of pedestrian access and entrance control systems. Gunnebo’s products include speed gates, mass-transit gates and security revolving doors used to control pedestrian access in commercial properties, public transportation facilities and other secure environments. The business will join ASSA ABLOY’s Pedestrian business segment within its Entrance Systems division. The company generated approximately €151 million in sales during 2025 and reported what ASSA ABLOY described as a good operating margin. ASSA ABLOY said the acquisition will broaden its pedestrian access portfolio while adding Gunnebo’s engineering capabilities, employees and industry experience. “Gunnebo Entrance Control’s well-established entrance control portfolio, strong team and deep industry expertise will enhance and complement our current offering in pedestrian access solutions.”
